purpose: Test the surviving mixed-characteristic / strongly-Rayleigh / real-stable polynomial route on the exact five-state rank-3 switch. Prove that no real multiaffine polynomial with exactly this support and all five coefficients nonzero can be real stable.

theorem.name: NO_REAL_STABLE_MULTIAFFINE_REWEIGHTING_OF_RANK3_SWITCH_SUPPORT
theorem.statement: For real nonzero a,b,c,d,e, f=a+bL+cM+dR+eLR is not real stable.
proof: For a real multiaffine stable polynomial, every Rayleigh difference Delta_ij=(partial_i f)(partial_j f)-f(partial_ij f) is nonnegative for all real substitutions of the remaining variables.
For the pair (L,R), partial_L f=b+eR, partial_R f=d+eL, and partial_LR f=e.

Because e and c are nonzero, Delta_LR is an affine function of the real variable M with nonzero slope. Therefore it takes both positive and negative values on R and cannot be nonnegative for every real M.
Hence f is not real stable.
theorem.canonical_explicit_zero: For p=1+L+M+R+LR=(1+L)(1+R)+M, take L=R=-2+i and M=2i. All three variables have positive imaginary part, while p=(-1+i)^2+2i=-2i+2i=0.

support_alignment.combinatorial: The support is exactly {empty,{L},{M},{R},{L,R}}, the five-state 2-vs-1 switch already proved not to be a delta-matroid.
support_alignment.literature: Branden's support theorem states that the support of a stable polynomial is a jump system; in the multiaffine case this is a delta-matroid. The direct Rayleigh proof above is stronger for this exact real-support family because it rules out every nonzero real coefficient reweighting explicitly.

killed: Make the exact local switch polynomial strongly Rayleigh / real stable by changing its five nonzero real coefficients.
Apply a direct real-stable mixed-characteristic/interlacing algorithm that requires preserving the exact five-state local support.
Obtain the exact carrier as a determinant of a Hermitian/PSD linear pencil whose multiaffine support would be real stable without adding/canceling extra states.
not_killed: A global stable polynomial with extra intermediate states that cancel/project nonlocally before the final SAT decision.
The oriented P0 coefficient carrier using sign data beyond stability/rank.
A source-specific three-layer claw augmentation theorem.

next_target.name: E8_ORIENTED_P0_CLAW_CANCELLATION_OR_AUGMENTATION_V3_3
next_target.directive: Do not retry PSD/real-stable/interlacing inheritance. Work with the exact oriented K2/K3 principal-minor carrier or the equivalent three-layer induced-claw system. Seek either a polynomial global sign/Pfaffian cancellation identity or a blossom-like claw contraction with a polynomial progress measure and exact witness reconstruction.

sources: P. Branden, Polynomials with the half-plane property and matroid theory, Advances in Mathematics 216 (2007), 302-320.
D. G. Wagner and Y. Wei, A criterion for the half-plane property, Discrete Mathematics 309 (2009), 1385-1390.
